notes: DLC inheritance follows refkey/refurl across checked-in VanillaReference CFG files.

base_family controls BPRUE module inheritance; comparison_base independently controls signature analysis.
Missing cross-file sources are reported in unresolved_inheritance instead of silently producing misleading None diffs.
